name: Fraimic .bin (Spectra 6, controller order)
description: Composition PNG dithered to the six Spectra 6 inks and packed into the raw .bin a Fraimic canvas accepts on POST /api/image: 4 bits per pixel, no header, in the panel controllers' own byte order. The 31.5" Large Canvas (1440x2560) takes 2,304,000 bytes in eight controller blocks; the 13.3" (1200x1600) takes 960,000 bytes as a left half then a right half. app.fraimic uploads the file while the frame is awake.

settings.name: saturation
settings.label: Pre-quantise saturation
settings.help: Spectra 6 has only six pure colours; boosting saturation before the dither pass pushes near-palette tones onto exact palette values, killing speckle. 1.4 is the recommended out-of-the-box value; bump to 1.6+ for photos.

settings.name: calibrated
settings.label: Calibrated palette + tone mapping
settings.help: Experimental. Dithers against the panel's measured colours (a dusty red instead of pure red, etc.) and compresses the source range into the panel's reproducible band so Floyd-Steinberg has somewhere to spread error. Helps on photographic / colour-heavy content; can introduce a cool tint on neutral greys because the calibrated white is slightly green-blue. A/B with your actual dashboards before leaving on. Calibration data ported from the paperlesspaper/epdoptimize project (Apache 2.0).
